opportunities.name: Nonlethal Trident Window
opportunities.objective: Compare W nonlethal follow-up versus W kill/refund sequence.
opportunities.mechanic: If W's empowered attack fails to kill, it grants five seconds of AP magic damage on subsequent attacks. Nashor/Dusk and Dawn reward this actual attack window, and Q provides access. Cosmic and Riftmaker help stay close while W bleed continues.
opportunities.requiredState: First W attack does not kill and target remains reachable for follow-up attacks.
opportunities.failure: Evasion needs E, reducing attacks; target death ends the proposed sustained window.
opportunities.test: Compare W nonlethal follow-up versus W kill/refund sequence; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W kill cooldown refund and nonlethal five-second buff are alternative outcomes.

opportunities.name: Flat Reduction Brawler
opportunities.objective: Compare survival against equal-total small-packet and large-packet damage.
opportunities.mechanic: P reduces damage by 4 plus 0.01 AP per source. AP from Riftmaker/Deathcap can modestly increase reduction against repeated small packets; health/resists and Unending Despair buy close-combat time. E untargetability avoids a large threat, while W supplies sustained AP magic damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Incoming pattern must include repeated small hits; E timed for the large packet.
opportunities.failure: Reduction is tiny against burst and defense delays enough AP to matter.
opportunities.test: Compare survival against equal-total small-packet and large-packet damage; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Flat passive reduction is not percentage damage immunity.

ruledOut.reason: W/E are AP magic packets and Q has separately named physical/magic portions, with no ordinary crit rule.

unknowns: P minimum damage behavior and W/Dusk repetition require live logs; no infinite damage reduction is claimed.
Q primary description states on-hit application, while the resolved tooltip separates physical AD and magic AP packets; do not count the entire mixed Q as magic.

builds.name: Nonlethal Trident Window
builds.summary: Compare W nonlethal follow-up versus W kill/refund sequence.
builds.goal: Compare W nonlethal follow-up versus W kill/refund sequence.
builds.hypothesis: If W's empowered attack fails to kill, it grants five seconds of AP magic damage on subsequent attacks. Nashor/Dusk and Dawn reward this actual attack window, and Q provides access. Cosmic and Riftmaker help stay close while W bleed continues.
testPlan: Required state: First W attack does not kill and target remains reachable for follow-up attacks.
Compare W nonlethal follow-up versus W kill/refund sequence; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Evasion needs E, reducing attacks; target death ends the proposed sustained window.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W kill cooldown refund and nonlethal five-second buff are alternative outcomes.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Nashor's Tooth, Dusk and Dawn, Cosmic Drive, Riftmaker, Rabadon's Deathcap, Berserker's Greaves. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Passive: Fizz's Attacks cause his enemies to bleed, dealing [30 / 45 / 60 / 75 / 90 + (0.25) × AP] magic damage over [3] seconds. 

Active: Fizz's next Attack deals an additional [50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 + (0.45) × AP] magic damage. If this Attack kills its target, Fizz refunds [30 / 40 / 50 / 60 / 70] Mana and reduces the cooldown of this Ability to [1] second. If it does not kill, Fizz's Attacks deal an additional [20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 + (0.3) × AP] magic damage for [5] seconds.
Fizz dashes through an enemy, dealing [(1) × AD] physical damage plus [10 / 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage.

Fizz hops onto his trident, becoming Untargetable for 0.75 seconds, after which he deals [80 / 130 / 180 / 230 / 280 + (0.95) × AP] magic damage to nearby enemies and Slows them by [(0.4 / 0.45 / 0.5 / 0.55 / 0.6) × 100]% for [2] seconds. 

Fizz can Recast this Ability while Untargetable to dash again, which ends the effect early, deals damage in a smaller area, and doesn't Slow.
